name: Bear's Head
summary: On Bear's Head in southeastern Azshara, Timbermaw furbolgs keep their outposts beneath the cliffs. Their settlements link to larger homes farther north, while Archmage Xylem studies in a tower above.

sections.title: Furbolg Outposts and Cliffside Magic
sections.body: Timbermaw furbolgs keep outposts on Bear's Head, the high ground of southeastern Azshara. Their camps connect north to the larger dens at Ursolan and Timbermaw Hold. Above them, Xylem's Tower stands on the cliffs. Archmage Xylem studies arcane magic there in seclusion with his apprentices and high elven associates. The coast around them remains troubled.

faq.q: Why is this area called Bear's Head?
faq.answer: The Timbermaw furbolg settlements on these hills gave Bear's Head its name. Their camps here serve as southern outposts for the larger homes farther north.

faq.q: Which furbolgs live in Bear's Head?
faq.answer: Timbermaw furbolgs live in Bear's Head. Many furbolg tribes across Kalimdor fell to demonic corruption, but the Timbermaw have largely resisted the taint. Their settlements remain connected to Ursolan and Timbermaw Hold.

faq.q: What is the tower on the cliffs above Bear's Head?
aliases: who lives in the tower here
faq.answer: Archmage Xylem owns the tower on the cliffs above Bear's Head. The eccentric human wizard studies in seclusion in Azshara with a handful of apprentices and high elven associates.

angles.text: As a mage, you can seek advanced arcane training from Archmage Xylem. The powerful, eccentric spellcaster's tower overlooks Bear's Head.
